summary.name: Unzip One
summary.one_liner: Unzip One is a free Mac archive utility from Trend Micro's Cleaner One for opening, browsing, and creating compressed files in many formats.
use_cases: open RAR or ZIP files on a Mac
safely open archives from unknown sources
summary.what_it_does: Unzip One opens archived files including RAR, ZIP, 7z, GZIP, BZIP2, and many other formats, such as CAB, MSI, ISO-style images like ISO-related formats (listed as UDF, VHD, WIM, SquashFS, and others). It lets users drag files into the app to extract them. Users can open and browse compressed files without unarchiving them first. The app can be set as the default unzip app, and it describes a secure extraction feature to help guard against viruses in compressed files. The page also describes it as able to compress and encrypt files.
notable: Browse compressed files without unarchiving them
Secure extraction to guard against viruses in archives
Supports a long list of archive formats including RAR, 7z, ISO-related and Windows installer formats
